     : forall (World Event : Type) (backend : GatewayMachine.gateway_backend World Event) (ge : Clight.genv)
         (property : Memory.Mem.mem -> World -> Prop) (environment : Maps.PTree.tree (Values.block * Ctypes.type))
         (parameters : Maps.PTree.tree Values.val) (before : Memory.Mem.mem) (index : nat) 
         (value : Values.val) (dictionary integer bytes unicode symbol : Values.block),
       GatewayFramedRuntime.gateway_ambient_closed backend property ->
       index < 14 ->
       GatewayValueReturns.gateway_object_pointer_value value ->
       Maps.PTree.get GatewaySource._index parameters = Some (Values.Vint (Integers.Int.repr (BinInt.Z.of_nat index))) ->
       (forall identifier : AST.ident,
        List.In identifier
          (GatewaySource._host_has_type
           :: GatewaySource._PyDict_Type
              :: GatewaySource._PyLong_Type :: GatewaySource._PyBytes_Type :: GatewaySource._PyUnicode_Type :: nil) ->
        Maps.PTree.get identifier environment = None) ->
       Globalenvs.Genv.find_symbol (Clight.genv_genv ge) GatewaySource._host_has_type = Some symbol ->
       Globalenvs.Genv.find_funct_ptr (Clight.genv_genv ge) symbol =
       Some (Ctypes.Internal GatewaySource.f_host_has_type) ->
       Globalenvs.Genv.find_symbol (Clight.genv_genv ge) GatewaySource._PyDict_Type = Some dictionary ->
       Globalenvs.Genv.find_symbol (Clight.genv_genv ge) GatewaySource._PyLong_Type = Some integer ->
       Globalenvs.Genv.find_symbol (Clight.genv_genv ge) GatewaySource._PyBytes_Type = Some bytes ->
       Globalenvs.Genv.find_symbol (Clight.genv_genv ge) GatewaySource._PyUnicode_Type = Some unicode ->
       let selected_type :=
         if (PeanoNat.Nat.eqb index 4 || PeanoNat.Nat.eqb index 10)%bool
         then dictionary
         else
          if PeanoNat.Nat.eqb index 5
          then integer
          else if (PeanoNat.Nat.eqb index 8 || PeanoNat.Nat.eqb index 9)%bool then bytes else unicode
         in
       exists selected : Clight.temp_env,
         GatewaySourcePaths.gateway_source_path backend ge (Ctypes.Internal GatewaySource.f_host_has_type)
           (value
            :: Values.Vptr selected_type Integers.Ptrofs.zero :: Values.Vint (gateway_validation_optional index) :: nil)
           (gateway_outcome_field_type_cont environment selected) property
           (Clight.Returnstate value (gateway_validation_lookup_cont environment parameters) before) property /\
         Maps.PTree.get GatewaySource._index selected = Maps.PTree.get GatewaySource._index parameters /\
         Maps.PTree.get GatewaySource._data selected = Maps.PTree.get GatewaySource._data parameters /\
         Maps.PTree.get GatewaySource._value selected = Some value
